name: Vibrations
description: Free and forced vibration response of single-degree-of-freedom (SDOF) systems, undamped and damped vibration. Response to periodic excitation, impulse response, response to arbitrary excitation, convolution integral. Two degrees-of-freedom systems, orthogonality of modes, harmonic response, vibration absorbers. Multi-degrees-of freedom (MDOF) systems, modal analysis. Continuous systems, axial vibration of rods, bending vibration of beams, torsional vibration of rods, Rayleigh-Ritz method.
